Themed flextable with grouped section rows

Source: R/theme.R
ft_grouped.Rd

Renders one table out of several question blocks. Rows whose group entry is TRUE become section headings: bold, shaded in the palette's light tint, spanning the full width of the table; every other row is indented beneath the heading above it. This is the layout the vaccination coverage survey reports use for household and caregiver characteristics, where a dozen short questions would otherwise become a dozen separate tables.

ft_grouped(
  x,
  group,
  palette = vcs_palette(),
  font_size = 9,
  indent = 10,
  notes = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A data frame. Its first column holds the response labels and the section headings.

group

Logical vector, one entry per row of x, marking the section heading rows. Alternatively the name of a logical column of x, which is then dropped from the output.

palette

A vcs_palette().

font_size

Body font size in points.

indent

Indent applied to the response rows, in points.

notes

Optional character vector of footnotes.

...

Passed to ft_vcs().

Value

A flextable.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  d <- data.frame(Response = c("Sex", "Male", "Female"), Percent = c(NA, 7.4, 92.6))
  ft_grouped(d, group = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE))
}
#> Error in ft_grouped(d, group = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)): could not find function "ft_grouped"
